name: rc-auto
description: Turns Remote Control on when you type in a desktop-app session, and off after 24 idle hours.

keep_on_files.title: Extra keep-on files
keep_on_files.description: Paths of JSON files in the keep-on format ({"local_id": ...} or {"session_ids": [...]}), read besides ~/.claude/rc-auto-keep-on.json. ~ is your home folder.
